title: unified-rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow traffic + auto-rollback workflows
author: Asha Menon
description: Add unified rollout primitives and an automated rollback controller to support canary deploys, A/B tests, shadow traffic, and policy-driven auto-rollback. Motivation: customers need a single, simple model lifecycle API that expresses common production patterns (canary, gradual traffic, A/B, shadow) and lets the control plane automatically revert on quality regressions or infra errors. This change implements: 1) new Rollout CRD and API surface for specifying strategies and metrics; 2) rollout controller that orchestrates traffic splits, sanity checks, and gradient-based promotion; 3) shadow traffic plumbing that mirrors requests to a candidate without affecting responses; 4) auto-rollback policies that evaluate model-level and infra-level signals (latency, error-rate, quality regressions) and execute rollback with a safe cooldown. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (Linear ENG-1849) - [x] protobufs and API surface - [x] controller implementation with e2e tests - [x] UI rollout editor + validation - [x] CI and canary smoke tests - [x] docs and release notes Notes: kept compatibility with existing route pinning behavior; default policy is conservative (slow promotion, require SLOs). See commit list for implementation breaks and follow-ups.
commit_summary: Series of commits: initial CRD and protobufs; controller reconciliation loop; traffic manager and canary scaler; shadow proxy add; metrics-based rollback logic and e2e tests; UI and CLI hooks; bugfixes for kv-cache interaction and model aliasing.

release_notes: Introduces unified Rollout API to declaratively run canary, A/B, and shadow deployments with policy-driven auto-rollback; default conservative rollout policy to minimize user impact; UI and CLI support added; metrics-based rollback triggers included.
